verdict.rationale: A downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for a note-taking app with a developer ecosystem, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The obsidian-api GitHub repo describes an in-app TypeScript plugin interface (Vault), and Obsidian URI is a custom protocol for triggering actions; both are adjacent developer building blocks, not a published spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
